create_coordinator: create a Coordinator instance to manage coordinated stop signaling across multiple threads
request_stop_coordinator: request a Coordinator to stop all coordinated threads by setting its stop event
stop_on_exception_context: use the stop_on_exception context manager to halt all threads when an exception occurs
coordinated_get_from_queue: safely get an item from a shared queue while respecting the Coordinator stop signal
coordinated_put_to_queue: safely put an element into a shared queue while respecting the Coordinator stop signal
